title: jdisrest: distributed REST-based master/worker framework for jMetal-encoded optimization problems
description: Distributed REST-based master/worker framework for jMetal-encoded optimization problems. A Spring WebFlux master runs steady-state NSGA-II, MOEA/D, SMS-EMOA and PAES and dispatches the solution evaluations to remote workers, which can be written in Java, Python (with the bundled client and command-line worker), MATLAB or any other language that can make HTTP requests. Configuration files with a launcher run real-coded problems without writing a master.
